testExecutionEvidence: The successful final-tree preflight tests check covers the included Flutter test sources.

actualInputs: emulated hardware Tab, Enter, PageDown and Escape
android.accessibility: Named tabs, identified active panels and enabled/clickable/focusable Close button read from UIAutomator
android.keyboardReadiness: Native FlutterView plus expected logical focus checked before each selection or scrolling key
android.cleanupOwner: Parent restores normal APK and stops its emulator; driver restores its wm-size override

inputs.key: Enter activates the accessible Close button
Tab from selected usage tab into its panel
PageDown scrolls the focused usage panel
Escape closes only the active reader

pixelProofs.purpose: explanation preserves its independent scroll position
usage preserves its independent scroll position
closing and reopening resets explanation to the top
closing and reopening resets usage to the top
hardware PageDown scrolls the active panel

limitations: Legacy regression coverage is limited to eight preserved risk dialogs and sixteen intentionally updated directory/workspace frames.

Playwright implicitly hides source scrollbars in the unchanged comparison pipeline. A separate diagnostic confirms persistent source thumbs; its changed viewport geometry excludes it from acceptance comparisons.
The guide reader prose/usage profile is included; other modal and Markdown profiles remain pending in the family inventory.
Browser focus-history probes cover English in both themes at two native densities; they do not separately probe Chinese or every dialog caller.
Browser focus-history JSON does not record its browser version; the renderer pin is recorded separately in the source lock.
Whole-reader, tab and panel metrics are listed separately; no overall visual completion is inferred.
